_comment: Reference values for lammps-data-build. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-data-build:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022, Mishin Cu EAM).
_calibration_note: L4 run-0 PE of the exact 3x3x3 FCC supercell (a=3.615 A) is deterministic: 5 oracle runs identical, total PE -382.34358 eV / 108 atoms. Tolerance 2e-4 eV/atom is ~4x the observed deviation of a hand-rolled a=3.60 A lattice (7.9e-4 eV/atom) below which a forgery cannot pass; the correct structure reproduces the ref exactly (print precision).
